---
title: "Privacy Fatigue"
---

Modern users face repeated privacy choices. This project studies how repeated privacy decision-making may produce fatigue, lower engagement, and less protective behavior.

## Core question

Can repeated privacy decisions lead to measurable privacy fatigue, and how does that fatigue affect behavior?

## Methods

- Repeated decision tasks
- Survey measurement
- Behavioral outcomes
- Structural equation modeling or mixed-effects modeling

## Applied goal

Identify design strategies that reduce unnecessary burden without removing user control.
